credit: The riddle → reward flow follows oncyberio/game-server-v2 template.md (MIT). The matcher is AIML-like — Dr. Richard S. Wallace, A.L.I.C.E. (1995–1999). Answers are compared case-, whitespace- and punctuation-insensitively; every entry in `a` is accepted.

riddles.q: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with the wind. What am I?
What has keys but opens no locks, space but no room, and you can enter but not go inside?
I am tall when I am young and short when I am old. What am I?
The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?
I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and water but no fish. What am I?
What is always in front of you but cannot be seen?
riddles.hint: It arrives one day at a time.

riddles.q: What is so fragile that saying its name breaks it?
What gets wetter the more it dries?
I am light as a feather, yet the strongest person cannot hold me for five minutes. What am I?
I prove who you are without saying your name, and anyone may check me but only you may make me. What am I?
I am chained to my parent by a hash and every child of mine remembers me forever. What am I?
riddles.hint: One is minted every twelve seconds on Ethereum.
